name: keep-cells
description:
A whole cell is found or not. remove clears a found cell (with "empty", it drops the rows); extract keeps the cell, or an empty cell if not found.

kind: "contains", "starts", "ends" (with items: text parts, case and ё do not count; or with prepositions: the first, the last or any word is a bundled preposition, as written, «для,» is none); "regex" (with pattern); "empty" (no characters at all: a cell of spaces is not empty); by occurrence among the cells, in any case and ё as е: "unique" (once), "repeated" (more than once), "first", "last" occurrence. Empty cells are never repeats of each other.
items: the text parts for "contains", "starts" and "ends".
pattern: the regular expression for "regex".
prepositions: for "contains", "starts" and "ends", look for a bundled preposition instead of items.

keep-cells keeps only the rows where the matcher finds something in the working column.

Example: semkit read core.csv keep-cells contains --items бесплатно,скачать write out.csv

options.name: --items
options.description: the text parts for "contains", "starts" and "ends". Items: a comma list 'a,b', @FILE (one item per line, or the first column of a table) or @NAME of a list.

options.name: --prepositions
options.description: for "contains", "starts" and "ends", look for a bundled preposition instead of items.
